body: ## Pull request overview Guards two legacy code paths that could throw NPEs during edge conditions: (1) legacy fluid-flow prediction when encountering water-like block states that don’t expose `LEVEL` (notably bubble columns), and (2) proxy alert send/receive checks when configuration is transiently unavailable during startup/reload. **Changes:** - Added `LEVEL`-property presence checks before reading legacy liquid level and falling-liquid logic. - Treated bubble columns as source water (`depth=0`) for legacy liquid-depth calculations. - Made proxy alert `canSendAlerts` / `canReceiveAlerts` safely no-op when `ConfigManager` is temporarily `null`. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | common/src/main/java/ac/grim/grimac/utils/nmsutil/FluidTypeFlowing.java | Prevents legacy fluid prediction from reading `LEVEL` on states that don’t define it; special-cases bubble columns as source water. | | common/src/main/java/ac/grim/grimac/events/packets/ProxyAlertMessenger.java | Avoids proxy alert send/receive NPEs by short-circuiting when config is unavailable. | --- 💡 Add Copilot custom instructions for smarter, more guided reviews.
